world.name: Movement Workshop
world.blurb: Movement studies, Woods routes and Causeway machinery puzzles with and without dash.

rooms.name: The Broken Relay

workshopRoutes.name: One solution

rooms.question: Reach the flag across both counterweights.
rooms.hint: Save the dash for the transfer. Leave the second weight while it is still lifting you.

rooms.name: Behind the Counterweight

workshopRoutes.name: One solution

rooms.question: Open the passage, then find a way back above it.
rooms.hint: The raised weight opens the way. Its return brings a foothold back into reach.

rooms.name: Under the Lintel

workshopRoutes.name: One solution

rooms.question: Reach the flag.
rooms.hint: The wall divides the lift from the flag. Keep the dash for the opening beyond the carrier track.

rooms.name: The Return Ferry
rooms.question: Prepare the lower return, then bring the shard home.
rooms.hint: Touch the hanging weight before taking the shard. Its empty space exposes the return crystal while the ferry is still within reach.

workshopRoutes.name: One solution

rooms.workshopObjective: Prepare the lower return, then bring the shard home.
rooms.workshopReturnText: SHARD FOUND · RETURN THROUGH THE LOW GATE

rooms.name: The Counterweight Engine
rooms.question: Take the upper seal, then use the returning weight to reach the flag.
rooms.hint: The same weight launches you, clears the lower throat, then becomes your returning foothold. The upper pocket restores a dash, not the weight's clock.

workshopRoutes.name: One solution

rooms.workshopObjective: Take the upper seal, then use the returning weight to reach the flag.
rooms.workshopReturnText: SEAL FOUND · REACH THE UPPER FLAG

rooms.name: The Smuggler's Circuit
rooms.question: Bring the far seal to the upper home flag.
rooms.hint: Prepare the low gate outward. Save the high lift for your return. The returning ferry is the only place to regain enough height for the home crystal.

workshopRoutes.name: One solution

rooms.workshopObjective: Bring the far seal to the upper home flag.
rooms.workshopReturnText: SEAL FOUND · REACH THE UPPER FLAG

rooms.name: The Divided Tower

workshopRoutes.name: Upper route · rising launch
Lower route · returning foothold

rooms.question: Reach the upper flag.
rooms.hint: One weight, two journeys. Use its rising launch to reach the high crystal, or its returning position to leave the lower wall.

rooms.name: The Falling Gallery
rooms.workshopReturnText: SHARD FOUND · RETURN THROUGH THE FALLEN GALLERY
rooms.question: Bring the gallery shard home.
rooms.hint: Your outward foothold becomes the return opening. The ferry keeps moving while you visit the shard wall.

workshopRoutes.name: One solution · gallery loop
Alternate return · search solution

rooms.name: The Borrowed Branch

workshopRoutes.name: Borrow the branch, restore the trunk

rooms.question: Which obstacle becomes your next foothold?
rooms.hint: Dash through the amber trunk onto the blue branch. Jump and ring the bell to restore the trunk, then climb toward the flag.

rooms.name: The Crooked Orchard

workshopRoutes.name: Prepare, preserve, then change

rooms.question: Which branch should remain real after you leave the pod?
rooms.hint: Blue carries the approach; amber catches the pod rebound. Keep that catch real. At the high bough, prepare the phase that your final dash will leave behind.

rooms.name: The Hollow Crown

workshopRoutes.name: Cross the roots before restoring them

rooms.question: Where must you be before the roots become real again?
rooms.hint: Open the roots by removing the approach bough. The pod crosses without changing phase. Restore the roots only after the earlier ones are behind you, climb the far side, then leave the crown in the phase your last dash creates.

rooms.name: The Overturned Hollow

workshopRoutes.name: Open the floor, pass the ceiling, restore the landing

rooms.question: When is a missing ceiling useful, and when should it become your floor?
rooms.hint: The amber floor opens the descent when it disappears. Go beneath the dividing root. Rebound through the absent far cap before restoring it beneath you.

rooms.name: The Returning Seed

workshopRoutes.name: Outward diagonal rebound, open the roof, return from above

rooms.question: What changes when you return to the same pod from above?
rooms.hint: Bring all three seeds back to the gold flag. Follow the far bank, climb the outer branches, then collect the seed by the upper bell before returning through the pod housing.

rooms.name: The Bridge You Must Remove

workshopRoutes.name: Borrow the bridge, bring the shard, remove the ceiling

rooms.question: When does the bridge that helped you become the ceiling stopping you?
rooms.hint: Visit the far bank before removing your bridge. Return close to the hub on its right side, cut down-left to fold the bridge away, then use the plate below. Rise before steering left over the hub.

rooms.name: The Wrong First Turn

workshopRoutes.name: Stage B right, move A left, finish B upright

rooms.question: Which arm needs to pass its useful position before the other can move?
rooms.hint: B must visit up and continue to right. Then cycle A to left and visit the shard shelf. Only after that is B free to finish upright. A first can lock the pair; R restores their starting positions.

rooms.name: Leave Your Weight Behind

workshopRoutes.name: Leave the lantern, clear the hub, recover your weight

rooms.question: Who keeps the plate lowered while you work at the distant hub?
rooms.hint: Leave the lantern resting on the recoil plate. At the lower service ledge, cut upward twice: the arm must pass through the plate’s former position before pointing down. Return for the lantern, then use the cleared upper passage.

rooms.name: The Landing You Must Spend

workshopRoutes.name: Spend the landing

rooms.question: Which landing must give back your dash before you take it away?
rooms.hint: Launch and dash onto the arm. Let the landing restore your charge before folding it down. Drop inside the shaft, then dash through the lower opening.

rooms.name: The Obstruction Is Your Landing

workshopRoutes.name: The obstruction becomes the landing

rooms.question: Where must the obstruction stop so it can become your next landing?
rooms.hint: Get to the stone’s left side and dash it right through the guarded port. Return above, fold the arm from the service ledge, then dash into the shaft. The parked stone restores the charge you need at the lower exit.

rooms.name: Your Shortcut Cannot Carry the Weight

workshopRoutes.name: Deliver the weight before removing the bridge

rooms.question: Have you delivered the weight before folding away its only bridge?
rooms.hint: Carry the lantern across B and leave it on the plate. Fold B upright, then dash back empty-handed. A can now pass through right to down. Return to the plate, put the recovered lantern aside, and launch through the opened upper route.

rooms.name: The Root That Stops the Stone

workshopRoutes.name: Make the stop, then remove it
Restore the climbing root, then dash it away

rooms.question: When must the root stop the stone, and when must it disappear?
rooms.hint: Set blue before shoving the stone. The dash restores its amber stop. Reach the parked stone, ring the upper bell to open the root, then use the pod without removing the blue landing. Alternatively, restore the upper root, climb it, and dash it away to reveal blue.

rooms.name: Two Ways Through the Canopy

workshopRoutes.name: Upper — prepare before the approach
Lower — prepare from inside

rooms.question: Which bell order belongs to the route you chose?
rooms.hint: Upper: prepare blue before the approach dash, preserve amber at its pod, then prepare blue again. Lower: approach without ringing the first bell, preserve blue through the pods, then ring amber and dash through the lower exit. Both finish by dashing back to amber.

rooms.name: The Ferry Beneath the Roots

workshopRoutes.name: Prepare the ferry, return beneath the roots

rooms.question: What must be moving before you remove the route back?
rooms.hint: Prepare blue and touch the ferry before taking the upper path. Bring the far shard home. Ring amber to reveal the return ledge, catch the ferry without dashing, and use its homeward movement to cross below the divider before dashing up to blue.

rooms.name: The Weight You Can Finally Move

workshopRoutes.name: Transfer the load, free the launch

rooms.question: When has the machine taken over the job your weight was doing?
rooms.hint: Load the first plate with the lantern, then turn the arm right. Retrieve the lantern from the side: the arm holds the plate down. Carry it to the lower plate, turn the arm down, and return for the freed recoil launch.

rooms.name: The Dock You Need Only Once

workshopRoutes.name: Use the temporary dock, then send it onward

rooms.question: Why park the stone short of its final destination?
rooms.hint: B begins down as the temporary stop. Shove the stone against it. Turn A into a bridge, use the stone to reach the far service ledge, and turn B left for the return bridge. Shove the stone onward, return along B, and turn it up from the far ledge for the final launch.

rooms.name: The Load That Opens the Lift

workshopRoutes.name: Leave the load, reuse the lift

rooms.question: What keeps the door open while the lift brings you back?
rooms.hint: Use the lift to reach the lantern, bring it down to the pressure plate, then take the lift again empty-handed. The load keeps the distant door open.

rooms.name: The Descending Invitation

workshopRoutes.name: Visit below, launch on the return

rooms.question: When should you board a lift that first moves away from the flag?
rooms.hint: Touch the lift to send it down. Visit both shards, board it below, then jump from its upward return toward home.

rooms.name: The Lantern and the Missing Root

workshopRoutes.name: Blue cargo road, amber finish

rooms.question: Which phase can your cargo bring home?
rooms.hint: Prepare the blue bridge and missing amber root before carrying the lantern home. Leave it on the plate, then dash through the opened ceiling to restore the amber landing.

rooms.name: The Landing You Make in Midair

workshopRoutes.name: Rise first, restore the landing late

rooms.question: When can the branch become solid without stopping your rise?
rooms.hint: Jump above the pod and cut down while the blue cap is absent. Rise through it before dashing upward to make the blue landing real.

rooms.name: The Spring Under the Stone

workshopRoutes.name: Move the ceiling, launch onto it

rooms.question: Where should the ceiling go so it can catch your next jump?
rooms.hint: Dash the stone toward its distant stop. The opened spring launches you onto the stone; recover there before the final crossing.

rooms.name: The Launch Waiting on the Return

workshopRoutes.name: Spring to lift, return to launch

rooms.question: Which release prepares the launch you will need later?
rooms.hint: Load the spring, recoil onto the high lift, and send it down. Visit the shard below, board again, then use the rising return for the flag.
